title: India Cyber Threat Scorecard
description:
Aggregate counts of observed cyber threat activity affecting organisations in India, across 23 industry verticals, published monthly. Counts only: no organisation is named, described or made identifiable. A count is an observation, not a confirmed breach, and a band measures observed activity in a vertical, not the security posture of any organisation in it.

This is a dated snapshot. A new edition is published at the start of each month at bitscore.in/reports/india-threat-scorecard.
